source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.growth_habit: Short, rhizomatous, erect to ascending deciduous shrub to ca. 2 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Very short petioles; elliptic-orbicular blades, entire or with a few blunt teeth, usually <4 cm long, rarely to 6 cm
morphology_documented.flowers: Small dense axillary spikes; inconspicuous funnelform greenish-white, sometimes brown-red corollas 3–5 mm long
morphology_documented.fruit: Usually two-stoned drupes, coral-red to pink or purple-tinged, 5–7 mm long, persisting
morphology_documented.habitat: Woods and thickets; may increase under disturbance
